login.title: Canvas account
login.subtitle: Sign in, then connect your own Canvas access token so Claude can read Canvas as you.

sessionEnded.title: Your session has ended
sessionEnded.body: Sign in again to continue. Anything you had typed but not saved was not kept.

noProviders.title: No sign-in method is set up
noProviders.body: The server owner has not configured a sign-in provider yet.

loadFailed.title: Could not load the sign-in options

login.appWaiting: An app is waiting for you to sign in. After you sign in you will be asked whether to let it in.

signedOut.title: Canvas account
signedOut.body: Sign in, then add your own Canvas access token. Claude then reads Canvas as you, and only with your permission.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your account was created, but an owner has to approve it before you can add a Canvas token. Check back later.
pending.hint: Once you are approved, refresh to continue.

local.usernameHelp: Unique account login name; email-style names are supported.
local.passwordHelp: Use 15–128 characters. Spaces and Unicode are allowed.
local.changeHelp: Changing your password ends existing sessions and connected app grants. Sign in again afterwards.

upn.required: Choose a unique account UPN before connecting an MCP client.
upn.help: Your account id and linked identities remain unchanged. Saving ends existing sessions and connections.
